correctness.rationale: The involution quotient field is exactly the smooth elliptic quartic E_a. Conjugating by the rational cube-root automorphism gives a second independent elliptic quotient, as proved by explicit action on the two-dimensional differential basis, hence J(C_a) is F19-isogenous to E_a^2. Exhaustive nineteen-term quadratic-character sums give the complete six-class partition; direct F19 and F361 curve-point counts performed by an independent extension-field-norm algorithm agree for all fifteen admissible a. The proof does not extrapolate from finite tests to arbitrary coefficients or fields.

value.rationale: The complete parameter domain and seven hull-profile classes are singled out by Beshaj--Shaska, whose main counterexample leaves the arithmetic isogeny relationship of its two curves unspecified. The calculation exhaustively classifies the natural 15-member family by a second intrinsic invariant, detects a three-pair collapse to one class including *different* hull-profile classes, and determines every zeta function and all extension-point counts. It is a complete motivated natural finite classification, not an arbitrary sample, renaming or generic theoretical restatement.
